note: The minister's vote speech of 13 April 2018 names E-Policing without saying what it does, so it cannot be classed and gives no fact. What it does state: E-Policing and N-ABIS rolled out to most crucial infrastructures, and N$64,240,000 sought for the Information and Communication Technology programme in 2018/19, a domestic budget line for the ministry's ICT as a whole and not for E-Policing by name.
